grammar.label: legal and official markers — hereby, thereof, pursuant to, whereas
grammar.form: fixed adverb or preposition in a formal document

explanation.en: 'Hereby' means 'by this document', 'thereof' means 'of that', 'pursuant to' means 'following', and 'whereas' opens a recital of background. They are receptive vocabulary for most learners: recognise them, and write plainly yourself.
explanation.uz: 'hereby' — 'shu hujjat bilan', 'thereof' — 'uning', 'pursuant to' — 'ga muvofiq', 'whereas' — kirish bandini boshlaydi. Ularni tanish kifoya; o'zingiz sodda yozganingiz ma'qul.

grammar.positive_example: The parties hereby agree to the terms set out below.
grammar.negative_example: The parties hereby agree by this contract to the terms set out below.

l1_notes.uz: Bu so'zlar faqat huquqiy matnlarda uchraydi; kundalik yozuvda ishlatilsa, sun'iy eshitiladi.

grammar.label: shall in regulations and contracts
grammar.meaning: imposes a duty, not a prediction

explanation.en: In a regulation 'shall' means 'must': 'The tenant shall keep the property in good repair' is an obligation, not a forecast. Outside legal drafting this use is dying, and plain-English guidance now prefers 'must'.
explanation.uz: Qonun matnida 'shall' — 'must' ma'nosini beradi, kelasi zamonni emas. Huquqiy matndan tashqarida bu qo'llanish yo'qolib bormoqda.

grammar.positive_example: The tenant shall notify the landlord within seven days.
grammar.negative_example: The tenant shall probably notify the landlord within seven days.

l1_notes.uz: 'shall' ni kelasi zamon deb tarjima qilish huquqiy matnda jiddiy xato — u majburiyatni bildiradi.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: The school and the district have to sign something. Read me what you have written.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'The parties hereby agree that the school shall keep the building open until 2030.'

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: 'Shall' is right there. In a contract it is a duty, not the future.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: It means the agreement happens by these very words, on this page. Nowhere else would you write it.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Clause four says 'the building and the land thereof'.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: The land of the building. Old, and exact. Nobody can argue about which land.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then why does it sound like a hundred years ago?

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Because it is, and because a word that has been argued over in court for a hundred years is a word whose meaning is settled.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: 'Pursuant to clause nine, notice shall be given in writing.'

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Good. Now never write 'pursuant to' in a letter to a parent.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: And a writer who can tell them apart. That is the whole of it.
